scope: Action-conditioned industrial dynamics prediction; proposed benchmark, not a completed evaluation
source_status: Primary-source review; only DaISy dryer and glass-furnace data were downloaded and parsed; no model evaluations

candidates.name: Multistage extraction
candidates.notes: New external equation relative to ICDS templates; verify nominal bounds and units from code and original reference; Gym observation may contain setpoints.

candidates.name: Distillation column
candidates.notes: Candidate source code identifies R,F inputs; integration and physical validity need preflight.

candidates.name: CSTR series with recycle
candidates.notes: Distinct equation from single CSTR; reactor source family has prior development exposure, so not a completely unseen source.

candidates.name: Photoproduction
candidates.notes: Light intensity and nitrate feed; qualify as bioprocess simulation, not factory measurement.

candidates.name: Industrial dryer
candidates.notes: 10-second sampling; determine which input channels are controllable versus operating conditions; chronological split required; redistribution license not confirmed.

candidates.name: Philips glass furnace
candidates.notes: Three heating/cooling inputs; six temperature outputs; physical sampling time absent in description, inspect original records; redistribution license not confirmed.

candidates.name: Electro-mechanical positioning system
candidates.notes: Use applied force vir, not reference position as a substitute; closed-loop collection; official train/test and initialization window.

candidates.name: Cascaded tanks with overflow
candidates.notes: Pump actuation to measured water level; missing internal tank state requires history; tank mechanism resembles ICDS but measurement/source differs.

candidates.name: Silverbox
candidates.notes: Electronic Duffing analogue; separate official multisine and increasing-amplitude tests; do not count test subsets as independent systems.

candidates.name: Wiener-Hammerstein
candidates.notes: Dynamic linear-nonlinear-linear cascade; official IFAC SYSID benchmark; sequential history required.

candidates.name: KUKA industrial robot
candidates.notes: Report read; prepared forward dataset is motor torque and position, raw velocity information is additional; 39988 train and 3636 test points, 100ms; report measured torque estimated from current; not a full-state dataset by default.

candidates.name: Coupled electric drives
candidates.notes: Technical report Uppsala 2017; absolute speed measurement loses sign; short records constrain context lengths.

candidates.name: Liquid-saturated steam heat exchanger
candidates.notes: Liquid flow controls outlet temperature; other inlet quantities held fixed; 1-second sampling; related mechanism already present in ICDS.

candidates.name: Parallel Wiener-Hammerstein
candidates.notes: Automatica 2015 source; amplitude extrapolation; same broad family as WH, keep group relationship.

candidates.name: CubeSpec fine steering mirror
candidates.notes: ISMA-USD2024; three actuator voltages and three displacements; periodic multisines at three amplitudes, no transients; not a manufacturing-factory dataset.

candidates.name: Polymerisation reactor
candidates.notes: T,M,I states; F,Tf,Mf,If inputs; original reference and validity bounds need audit.

candidates.name: Crystallization
candidates.notes: Code returns 7 components but 5 moment/concentration states drive RHS; CV and Ln are derived quantities; audit redundancy and initial conditions before use.

candidates.name: Siemens Industrial Benchmark
candidates.notes: IEEE SSCI2017; partial observation, delays and heteroskedasticity; not measured factory data; history track required.

candidates.name: NeoRL-2 Pipeline/DMSD/Fusion
candidates.notes: 2025 preprint as verified; seven simulated tasks; transition tuple API and simulators; validate observation Markovness, hidden actuator states and data licenses per task.

candidates.name: BOPTEST building HVAC
candidates.notes: DOE/LBNL report and JBPS2021; actual actuator points and weather disturbances; container/FMU setup and hidden thermal state make it slower for MVP.

candidates.name: Tennessee Eastman process
candidates.notes: Public fault-detection variant is not automatically an action-conditioned dynamics benchmark; inspect manipulated-variable availability and excitation; not real factory data.

candidates.name: PDEBench
candidates.notes: NeurIPS2022; borrow multi-step and physics metrics; spatial-field interface and lack of a common actuator task make it unsuitable for first CAQ release.

methodological_references.name: DynaDojo
methodological_references.lesson: Vary context/sample size, system complexity and OOD; source generator and challenge API are separate.

methodological_references.name: PC-Gym
methodological_references.lesson: Reuse independently sourced process equations, not RL return as the dynamics score.

methodological_references.name: Deep subspace encoders / SUBNET
methodological_references.lesson: Use a proper history-to-hidden-state dynamics baseline on input-output datasets.

methodological_references.name: From system models to class models
methodological_references.lesson: Direct ICL system-identification comparator; the released family/schema must be matched to each target task.

methodological_references.name: Dynamics as Prompts / CAPTURE
methodological_references.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters; year/version should follow final DOI
methodological_references.lesson: Relevant sim-to-real ICL dynamics work; do not assume its robot-specific checkpoint handles arbitrary process schemas.

methodological_references.name: Parallel Wiener-Hammerstein identification
methodological_references.lesson: Real controlled nonlinear response data with amplitude tests.

methodological_references.name: Industrial dryer system identification
methodological_references.venue: IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control 42(7) (1997), 956–974, cited by dataset card
methodological_references.lesson: Industrial measurements with control-relevant inputs and multivariate outputs.
